propositions: Rebar cannot reconcile against self-hosted Jira Data Center because the Cloud adapter assumes REST v3 + ADF + PAT bearer auth + accountId-based identity, while DC requires REST v2 + wiki-markup/plain-text + PAT + name-based identity
Six critical field/value mapping and sanitization units are duplicated or reached via private imports across adapters/jira, creating a dependency inversion that would break if Cloud changes

The jira_family sub-seam consolidates shared mapping logic (value maps, sanitizers, link relations) into one implementation imported by both Cloud and DC backends, while parameterizing divergent concerns (rich text codec, user identity model) via contracts
DC backend requires HTTPS and rejects non-TLS URLs unless allow_insecure=true, never disables certificate verification, and reads the JIRA_PAT only from environment variables never from config files

The delivered implementation passes bidirectional reconciliation against Jira 8.17.1 Data Center (62 passed, 1 xfailed in live harness) with zero regressions to the Cloud path and no new runtime dependencies unless jira-datacenter extra is installed
